integrity.reproducibility: The included verify.py uses only the Python standard library and exact integer matrix arithmetic.

scientific_limitations: The computation is specific to the published 40-divisor configuration on a characteristic-two Enriques surface family.
The spectrum does not determine the index of the generated sublattice.
Related modular-boundary graph literature exists; exhaustive spectral-literature coverage was not completed.
title: Exact spectrum of the 40-divisor Enriques intersection matrix
